subject: groupClade and groupOTU on the same tree?

messages.author: 92d0d4fee7469235
messages.subject: groupClade and groupOTU on the same tree?
parts:
Hi,


I have a question about using groupClade and groupOTU on the same tree? I can do Plot 1 and Plot 2 but I would like to have a merge between two of them to get Plot 3.


Best,

Dawid


# download example

nwk <- system.file("extdata", "sample.nwk", package="ggtree")

tree <- read.tree(nwk)


# Plot 1: tree with colored branches 

tree <- groupClade(tree, node=c(14, 17, 21))

ggtree(tree, aes(color=group))


# Plot2: tree with colored tippoints 

cls <- list(c1=c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"),

            c2=c("F", "G", "H"),

            c3=c("L", "K", "I", "J"),

            c4="M")


tree <- groupOTU(tree, cls)

ggtree(tree) +

geom_tippoint(size=5, aes(color=group))

messages.author: 65135aac151a06a7
messages.subject: Re: groupClade and groupOTU on the same tree?
parts:
Both of these functions have a group_name function that you can use, just give them different names. These functions just return lists of the groups so they can be added to each other. The default name is "group" so it is just getting overwritten:

tree <- groupOTU(tree,cls, group_name="OTU_groups")
tree <- groupClade(tree, node=c(14,17,21), group_name="Clade_groups")

ggtree(tree, aes(color=OTU_groups)) + geom_tippoint(size=5,aes(color=Clade_groups)
